bounded_leaf: Exact public task model and ServerHandler ownership seam for principal-scoped tasks/get, tasks/update and tasks/cancel.
observations: Exact task.rs defines DetailedTask as { task: Task, payload: TaskPayload }; Task carries the server-generated stable task_id plus status/timestamps/TTL/poll interval, and DetailedTask::new forces Task.status to agree with the payload.
Exact GetTaskResult is the tasks/get response wrapper: result_type defaults to COMPLETE, optional _meta, and flattened DetailedTask. GetTaskResult::new(task) constructs the COMPLETE result.

Exact TaskAckResult is the empty COMPLETE acknowledgement used for tasks/update and tasks/cancel; the source explicitly says state changes are observed through the next tasks/get rather than through the acknowledgement.

Exact server dispatcher calls validate_tasks_capability before get_task, update_task and cancel_task, then forwards request.params plus RequestContext<RoleServer> into the corresponding ServerHandler override.

That dispatcher gate checks only whether server/client negotiated the Tasks extension. It does not enforce authenticated-principal ownership of task_id. Therefore a principal-scoped persistent implementation must fail closed inside each get/update/cancel override before any task-store read, state transition or cancellation side effect.

The exact field layout/constructors of GetTaskRequestParams, UpdateTaskRequestParams and CancelTaskRequestParams were not recovered within this bounded source-read slice because the connector response truncated the later portion of task.rs. No field names are inferred or invented here.
